Below is a quick‑look “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a **Friday** or **Monday**, giving you a three‑day break (Saturday‑Sunday‑holiday or holiday‑Saturday‑Sunday).  

| Date(s) | Holiday | Province(s) where it’s a statutory holiday | Notes |
|---------|---------|-------------------------------------------|-------|
| **Feb 18‑20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, Quebec) | 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Sat) |
| **Feb 18‑20** | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Sat) |
| **Feb 18‑20** | Heritage Day (Saskatchewan) | 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Sat) |
| **Feb 18‑20** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | 3‑day weekend (Mon‑Sat) |
| **Mar 17‑19** | St. Patrick’s Day (Newfoundland & Labrador) | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Apr 7‑9** | Good Friday | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **May 20‑22** | Victoria Day | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Sep 2‑4** | Labour Day | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Oct 7‑9** | Thanksgiving | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |
| **Nov 11‑13** | Remembrance Day | 3‑day weekend (Fri‑Sun) |
| **Dec 23‑25** | Christmas Day | 3‑day weekend (Sat‑Mon) |

### Quick Summary

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend? | Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|---------------|--------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sun) | No | – |
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Yes | Feb 18‑20 |
| Louis Riel Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Yes | Feb 18‑20 |
| Heritage Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Yes | Feb 18‑20 |
| St. Patrick’s Day (NL) | Mar 17 (Fri) | Yes | Mar 17‑19 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Yes | Apr 7‑9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | Yes | May 20‑22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) | No | – |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Yes | Sep 2‑4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Yes | Oct 7‑9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Fri) | Yes | Nov 11‑13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Mon) | Yes | Dec 23‑25 |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tue) | No | – |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> If you want to support province‑specific holidays, you can flag each holiday with the provinces that observe it. For example, Family Day is observed in most provinces except BC, NB, NL, PEI, and QC (which have their own holidays). St. Patrick’s Day is only a statutory holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the list broken down by province or if you need additional details (e.g., public‑sector vs. private‑sector observances).
